name: Rearrange PDF Pages (Drag Thumbnails)

seo.title: Rearrange PDF Pages (Drag Thumbnails) — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: Render local PDF thumbnails, reorder pages with keyboard-accessible controls and export a newly ordered PDF.

assumptions: A new document is assembled from selected source pages.
limitations: Digital signatures, incremental revision history and some document-level features may not survive reconstruction.
